title: Proof of concept: the verdict
central_question: Can the engine stage a character-driven documentary shot?
content_notes: Characters are illustrated representations, not likenesses; no real photograph, footage or document is imitated. No dialogue is invented: people do not speak, only the narrator.

lines.text: October 1982: guilty of murder. Life, with hard labour.

claims.text: On 29 October 1982 Lindy was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment with hard labour.
